about: Findings Watchtower's team read in exact platform file versions (by sha256). One entry applies only to that file, those bytes, that rule and line. Paths are under the home folder; each (path, sha256) pair is a line of rules/platform-release.lock. Batch 5 (d2, Ken's decision 1, Oct 18).

entries.note: Grok Bot's sign-in skill tells the Bot not to bring up 1Password with people who don't use it. It's about not pushing a product, not about hiding anything.
Grok Bot's sign-in skill uses the platform's own sign-in tool, which can use logins saved in 1Password once you connect it. That's how sign-in is meant to work.
